User1 shares a memory of reading a sci-fi story about moral dilemmas and technology, prompting a connection to the current discussion.
User2 brings up the challenge of unpredictable human behavior, like jaywalkers, complicating autonomous decisions.
They invent a scenario where all vehicles are autonomous and debate its implications for societal safety.
User2 suggests exploring frameworks to ensure fair treatment of diverse groups in algorithm design.
